name: Snowbank Campground
evidence: rec.gov 233930 catalog: no per-site Proximity to Water flag on any site; satellite at 45.2898,-110.5495 with site coords plotted: Mill Creek gravel channel ~15-25 m N of sites 009-011 behind a riparian conifer band, site 011 overlooks the gravel bar ~50 m across open meadow; on-water not earned, view holds

name: Rombo Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234618 catalog: no per-site Proximity to Water flag; satellite at 45.7655,-114.2826 with site coords plotted: nearest pads (01/02/05 and the spur by the picnic table) ~40-70 m from the West Fork Bitterroot gravel bar/bank behind a continuous riparian tree band; operator 'along the river' is prose only

name: Parkside Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232773 catalog: drive-in RV sites 06-10 (45-50 ft) and 17-19, 21-23 tagged Proximity to Water 'Riverfront'; satellite at 45.0603,-109.4078 with site coords plotted: Main Fork Rock Creek channel ~25-30 m from sites 07-09 under open conifer canopy, lower loop 17-23 beside the braided channel; no legible contradiction

name: Emery Bay Campground
evidence: rec.gov 234484 catalog: drive-in RV sites 2-6 tagged 'Lakefront' (5: 38 ft, 6: 50 ft); satellite at 48.3333,-113.9490 with site coords plotted: site 6 ~10-15 m and site 5 ~25 m from the Hungry Horse high-water beach edge through a thin tree fringe (drawdown beach not counted against it)

name: Camp Sula
evidence: satellite at 45.8378,-113.9822: parked rigs ~27-31 m from the East Fork Bitterroot gravel channel behind a continuous conifer/riparian tree band along its west bank; operator 'river access on site' is prose only; no per-site map

name: Lake Five Resort
evidence: operator ResNexus per-site map (book/181a2646.../map?mapID=3): Lake Sites 1-12 in a row between the internal road and the shore; satellite at 48.4628,-114.0170 (155 m frame): their back-in spurs end ~10-15 m from the waterline through a thin, gappy shore fringe with paths to the water

name: Seeley Lake Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10227380 catalog tags loop 3 sites SLS27-29 'Lakefront'; satellite at 47.1915,-113.5160 with site coords plotted: those pads ~50-60 m from the shore with trees and the day-use beach between (on-water fails); SLS29 sits on open ground with the lake visible across it; loops 1-2 inland

name: Merry Widow Health Mine and Campground
evidence: operator hand-drawn site map (rates page) puts sites 14-28 and C-F along the Boulder River; satellite at 46.2685,-112.2500 (155 m frame): riverside row ~35-45 m from the riprap bank across an open gravel flat that also carries the footbridge path (used), sightline open; on-water not earned
